titles.romaji: Kamen Rider Zero-One: EVERYONE'S DAILY LIFE
titles.native: 仮面ライダーゼロワン EVERYONE'S DAILY LIFE

description:
Tie-in shorts for the Tokusatsu show Kamen Rider Zero-One released on the Toei Tokusatsu Fanclub (TTFC) app.

Note: Episode 5 was pre-screened on November 8, 2020, as a bonus for the Kamen Rider Zero-One: REALxTIME movie. The regular release was on February 1, 2021.
